request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: What enclosure rating (IP code) does the nanoScan3 laser scanner have when the optics cover and the system plug are mounted and the USB connection is closed with the protective cover?

response.text: {"kind": "text", "value": "IP65", "text": "The nanoScan3 has enclosure rating IP65 (IEC 60529) only when the optics cover and the system plug are mounted and the USB connection is closed with the protective cover. This is stated in the manual's Maintenance section 11.4 (Replacing the safety laser scanner, p. 112) and repeated in the Technical data, Ambient data table (Table 38) and its footnote 1 on p. 133.", "sources": [{"file": "nanoscan3-manual.md", "place": "11 MAINTENANCE — 11.4 Replacing the safety laser scanner (p. 112)", "quote": "Enclosure rating IP65 only applies if the optics cover and the system plug are mounted and the USB connection is closed with the protective cover."}, {"file": "nanoscan3-manual.md", "place": "14 TECHNICAL DATA — 14.2 Data sheet, Table 38: Ambient data (p. 132–133)", "quote": "Enclosure rating 1) IP65 (IEC 60529)"}, {"file": "nanoscan3-manual.md", "place": "14 TECHNICAL DATA — Table 38, footnote 1 (p. 133)", "quote": "The specified enclosure rating only applies if the optics cover and the system plug are mounted and the USB connection is closed with the protective cover."}]}
